title: Eiffel Tower 'pollution' prank on a fellow viewer

tellings.quote: I said, "Oh, by the way, your target today is probably not the Eiffel Tower."

plain: In the 1980s, inside a US military remote viewing unit, a team that tried to describe distant places and targets using only the mind, Army Sergeant Lyn Buchanan played a joke on a fellow viewer. He says he told the man, "Oh, by the way, your target today is probably not the Eiffel Tower." Buchanan tells Michels the story as one of the unit's in-jokes, a prank meant to plant an image in a colleague's head before a session.
